capability.summary: Vision-language direct-response instruction model with a sparse-expert architecture.
capability.problem_space: Vision-language model for visual grounding and document understanding. Applicable tasks include document OCR, chart interpretation, visual grounding, video question answering, visual reasoning. Accepts text, image, video input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions. Published distinction: The published architecture is sparse-expert, with 30 billion total and 3 billion active parameters. This is the direct-response instruction edition for text and visual tasks; model size and edition do not establish actual supplier latency or accuracy.

env_requirements: Valid API Key (Cloud) or GPU with Multimodal Support
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image, video | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.
